card.name: Dose words in dose-adjustment instructions
card.fires_on: The word dose, dosage or doses (or a piece of it) in instructions about adjusting, testing or titrating doses. It also fires on a few nearby words in the same setting, such as 'on' after 'Modify this dose based'.

modes.label: Other words in dosing sentences
modes.description: Words partway through dose-related text, such as a word piece in hemodialysis or 'on' in a dose-modification sentence.
